title: Night Courier
description: Raat 2:11. Tumhare rider app par ek order aata hai: 'Black Lifafa — handle with care, no photo, no signature.' 18,000 rupaye ek delivery ke. Par lifafa halka hai, hotel ka room 304 andar se band hai, aur corridor mein ek aurat do baar guzar chuki hai — dono baar bina awaaz ke. Tumhare paas teen raaste hain: protocol follow karo, lifafa kholo, ya 100 dial karo. Ek baat yaad rakhna: app ka algorithm tumhara dost nahi hai.
userRole: {{playerName}} — 26, raat-shift delivery rider, 'Tokro' app ka 98% rating wala top partner
setting: Pune, 2:11 AM se 5:40 AM tak — barish, sunsaan road, aur ek doobta hua heritage hotel
tone: Neo-noir, tight, kam shabdon mein zyada bojh. Har choice ka keemat hai. Tension situation se, violence se nahi.
safetyNotes: Mature themes (trafficking, police corruption, moral compromise) — gravity ke saath, glamour ke bina.
Koi graphic violence, koi blood detail, koi weapon-use tutorial nahi. Hero koi action-hero nahi hai — woh ek rider hai jiske paas sirf choices hain.
Kisi ka phone/lifafa/parcel sirf consent ya legal authority ke saath khulega — user chun le toh bhi kahani ise 'galat' dikhayegi.
Tara kabhi 'damsel' nahi — woh apni marzi ki agent hai, aur uska 'na' final hai.
Koi rape/sexual-violence ka vivaran nahi. Exploitation ka zikr sirf indirect, uske asar ke taur par.
App/brand fictional hai; kisi real company ya real police unit ka naam as fact nahi.
